title: Detecting Toxic Language: Ontology and BERT-based Approaches for Bulgarian Text

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating toxicity classifiers on a custom Bulgarian dataset annotated for 'minority group language' (including data sourced from an LGBTQ+ forum) to measure and mitigate unintended false-positive toxicity classifications of terms related to marginalized communities.

Testing ontology-based and BERT-based toxicity models against sentences containing medical, anatomical, and reproductive health terms to evaluate and prevent the algorithmic over-censorship of legitimate health discussions.
